Scenario: normal assistant text turn (oracle docs/upstream-sse-conversation.md
"message add" + "text increment" shapes).

Frames, in order:
1. "v1" protocol marker (tolerated, surfaced as raw).
2. resume_conversation_token: establishes conversation_id c-123; the token
   itself must never surface downstream.
3. assistant message add (o:"add", v.message with empty parts, in_progress):
   surfaces a message_id event, resets nothing (fresh text accumulator).
4. append patch on /message/content/parts/0 -> "Hello" delta.
5. bare {"v":" world"} continuation frame (path omitted; appended because the
   accumulator is non-empty and p/o are absent).
6. batch patch array: append "!" + status/end_turn replaces (non-text ops are
   no-ops for the text accumulator).
7. title_generation: auxiliary event, no text, surfaced as raw.
8. server_ste_metadata: updates tool_invoked=false / turn_use_case="text" in
   state, surfaced as raw.
9. [DONE] -> complete event with assembled text "Hello world!".
